exposure: Blunt expansion of uterine incision during caesarean delivery
Sharp expansion of uterine incision during caesarean delivery
cohort: 200 women undergoing caesarean delivery at a hospital in Faisalabad, Pakistan, were randomly assigned to either blunt or sharp expansion of the uterine incision.
finding: Blunt expansion of the uterine incision at caesarean delivery resulted in a significantly higher mean change in haematocrit compared to sharp expansion.
mod_finding: Blunt expansion of the uterine incision at caesarean delivery resulted in a significantly higher mean change in haematocrit compared to sharp expansion, indicating greater blood loss with the blunt technique during this mode of birth.
